audit_note: 31 audited findings. Reviewer verdicts: ChatGPT MAJOR (3 BLOCKERs, 9 MAJORs, 8 MINORs), Grok MINOR, Gemini MINOR. Post-audit: CONDITIONAL ACCEPTANCE after A1-A3 blockers. 4 internal-review gaps (G1-G4). Counts: VERIFIED 11, PARTIAL 8, OPINION 4, STALE 0, FALSIFIED 1, HOUSTON-DECISION 1. Total 31 findings.

findings.summary: parameter_summary.json column-permutation bug: H0=0.8035 is actually sigma8, not km/s/Mpc
Burn-in inconsistency: paper says 30% uniform but planck_bao_sn convergence_report.txt says 20%
Spectator-ALP 'natural parameter values' requires ~25x misalignment tuning — framing vulnerability
DES-Y5 + Pantheon+ SN catalogs have ~20% overlap; product likelihood unjustified without correction
309,189 samples without explicit 'raw accepted samples' qualifier in abstract
ΔN_eff prior allows negative values; should be quoted as one-sided upper limit under ΔN_eff≥0
Fig. 2 caption 'standard-ECH route via relativistic species is not viable' overstates stock-CAMB proxy run
'Full-tension' label implies full DES 3x2pt likelihood; it is only a compressed Gaussian S_8 prior
NaMaster validation 'ACT-like pipeline' overstates scope vs synthetic-sky pseudo-C_ℓ test
'Unbiased at |Δβ̂|≤0.040°' misleading: canonical estimator has 12% multiplicative bias
SNR=20.32 should not appear as headline; it is a diagonal matched-template ratio not detection significance
ALP MCMC is reparameterized summary-likelihood fit, not independent EB-spectra fit
Public repository has stale README with old v0.9 values; unrelated files mix with P1B artifacts
PACS numbers present; should be removed for MNRAS/JCAP target
Reference Cai2010quintomReview bib entry contains program-management prose in note field
PR3/PR4 wording inconsistency — footnote explicitly disambiguates published vs code artifacts
LCDM and ΛCDM used inconsistently in body text
M_Pl: reduced vs unreduced Planck mass not specified in ALP energy-density formula
LiteBIRD 'will settle this at ~9σ' overconfident without foreground/calibration qualification
HuggingFace links say 'in repository README' without v1B.0.54-specific HF dataset DOIs
Appendix A lacks commit SHA or immutable tag for v1B.0.54 frozen state; HF dataset DOIs missing
SNR disclaimer buried in footnote; should be promoted to main text at first SNR mention
Footnote density — several long footnotes could be shortened or moved to Appendix
Sentences in §III and §VI overly parenthetical
Artifact filenames scattered; should be consolidated into Artifact index table in Appendix A
ΔN_eff rendered inconsistently in PDF extraction — LaTeX source is consistent
PR4/NPIPE high-ℓ + 2018-release low-ℓ pairing: pairing-induced bias on ΔN_eff/H_0/S_8 unquantified
Planck-only accumulating chain mentioned in narrative but plays no role in conclusions
H_0 units: body uses km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹ while Table I header uses [km/s/Mpc] — inconsistent
Unweighted χ² template fit as canonical baseline without justification vs inverse-variance eliminating 80% bias
Draft correction notes '[Correction note: an earlier draft...]' visible in final body text
